如何实现高度的自动过渡 ​

  • 问题：一个高度自动的区域怎么实现下拉效果
html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta
    name="viewport"
    content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"
  >
  <title>Document</title>
  <style>
    .btn {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background-color: #007bff;
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16px;
      transition: background-color 0.3s;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      background-color: #0056b3;
    }

    .detail {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 0%;
      width: 300px;
      background-color: #fff;
      border-radius: 5px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in-out, visibility 0.3s ease-in-out;
    }

    .btn:hover .detail {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .content {
      padding: 20px;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #333;
    }

    .inner {
      max-height: 200px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding-right: 10px;
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <div class="btn">
    hover me
    <div class="detail">
      <div class="content">
        <div class=“inner”>
          Lorem, ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipisicing elit. Ducimus error eligendi fuga expedita, consequatur
          assumenda tempore iste qui est laudantium minus! Nulla earum aut, quasi, itaque minus, sint veritatis harum
          repellendus aperiam dignissimos vitae nostrum. Modi quod, laudantium ut nesciunt ratione earum possimus. Eius
          delectus, ducimus, vel optio ad, provident nulla dicta pariatur dolore beatae explicabo? Culpa nihil accusamus
          obcaecati!
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</body>

</html>
  • 解决方案
  1. 通过对内容区域设置最大高度来实现
css
.content{
  max-height:0;
  transition:2s;
}
.btn:hover .content{
  max-height:1000px;
}

缺点： 在不确定内容时可能会设置一个相对较大的最大高度，一如时过渡的时间过快，移出时间相对较慢，两段时间不一致。

  1. 通过JS实现 首先将内容区域设置为0
js
const btn =document.querySelector('.btn')
const detail =document.querySelector('.detail')
btn.onmouseenter=()=>{
  detail.style.height='auto';
  const h= detail.offsetHeight;
  detail.style.height='0';
  // 强制渲染
  detail.clientHeight; //读取任何几个位置信息，均能出发强制渲染
  detail.style.transition ='0.5s';
  detail.style.height=h+'px';
}
   ......

缺点:额外增加了js代码，增加更多代码量

  1. css新属性，尺寸差值interpolate-size
css
.content{
  max-height:0;
  transition:1s;
  /* 允许关键字 */
  interpolate-size: allow-keywords;
}
.btn:hover .content{
  max-height:auto;
}
/* css函数，目前处于试验阶段 */
.btn:hover .content{
  max-height:calc-size(auto,size);
}

缺点：可能存在兼容性问题，需要现代浏览器中使用
